failure_modes: The cash engine fell 100% from its 2020-12-31 peak to its 2021-12-31 trough and went negative and has not come back — the price recovering is optional, owner earnings recovering is not.

The cash engine buckled when the world tilted: the 2020 demand shock left owner earnings 288% ABOVE the prior peak (2020-12-31); the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 106% below the prior peak (2022-12-31) and it has not come back.

This business resists valuation: annual revenue growth is typically 70238 points away from its 39872%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 132205 points away from its -112209% average — what cannot be valued must be avoided however cheap it looks.
